items.name: tour-card
items.title: Tour card
items.description: The card of a guided tour from @cordwood/tour: it points at the current step's element, rings it and carries the buttons.

items.name: survey-prompt
items.title: Survey prompt
items.description: One NPS, CSAT or CES question for @cordwood/surveys, with its scale, an optional comment and a way to dismiss it.

items.name: changelog-dialog
items.title: Changelog dialog
items.description: The release notes of @cordwood/changelog behind a button with an unread dot, and the switch for receiving them by e-mail.

items.name: unsubscribe-card
items.title: Unsubscribe card
items.description: The page an unsubscribe link opens: it reads the code after # and posts it once the person confirms.

items.name: subscription-card
items.title: Subscription card
items.description: A tenant's subscription from @cordwood/billing: its status, its next date, and the way to Checkout or the customer portal.

items.name: members-table
items.title: Members table
items.description: A tenant's members from @cordwood/auth, with the role of each and the way to change it or remove them.
